book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Yɨɨsu araja Yɨrusarɨɨmu kusigukuru ya Amabhuru
Akʉmara Yɨɨsu akatanga kwiruguura mucharʉ cha Gariraaya. Atɨɨndirɨ kwiruguura mucharʉ cha Yudeya, kʉ kʉbha abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhaarɨ bhareenda kumwita.
Ribhaga riyo, isigukuru ya Amabhuru ya Abhayaahudi
yaarɨ ɨrariirɨ.
Neho abhanyi bha Yɨɨsu bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉtasaaga hanʉ, ujɨ Yudeya, korereke abhɨɨga bhaazʉ bharore ɨbhɨsɨgʉ bhɨnʉ okokora.
Arɨɨbhɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ areenda akumukɨ kʉbhaatʉ, atahocha emeremo jazɨ kwa mbisi. Mmbe, arɨɨbhɨ awɨ ʉratʉra kokora amangʼana gayo, nuujɨ wiiyeerekenʼye kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, korereke bhakomenye.”
Abhanyi bhaazɨ bhakabhugabhu, kʉ kʉbha nʉʉrʉ ebho abheene bhatiisiriiryɨ Yɨɨsu.
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ribhaga ryanɨ ryu ukuja iyo, rɨkɨɨrɨ kuhika, nawe imwɨ mʉratʉra kuja ribhaga ryʉryʉsi.
Abhaatʉ bhɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ, bhataana cha kʉbhabhiihirirwa imwɨ. Nawe bharambiihirirwa inyɨ, kʉ kʉbha nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, amahocha gaabhʉ nɨ‑mabhɨ.
Imwɨ abheene, mujɨ Yɨrusarɨɨmu kurya isigukuru. Inyɨ nɨtakuja, kʉ kʉbha ribhaga ryanɨ rɨkɨɨrɨ kuhika.”
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aamarirɨ kʉgamba amangʼana gayo, akasaaga Gariraaya.
Nawe hanʉ abhanyi bhaazɨ bhaagiirɨ Yɨrusarɨɨmu kurya isigukuru yiyo, Yɨɨsu wʉʉsi akaja iyo, nawe kwa mbisi, atiiyɨrɨkiryɨ habhwɨrʉ.
Mmbe, ribhaga ryi isigukuru, abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhakatanga komohya Yɨɨsu, bhakabhuurya abhaatʉ, “Arɨ hayi ʉmʉʉtʉ wurya?”
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakabha bharahakaana igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu. Abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Yɨɨsu nɨ‑mʉʉtʉ mʉzʉmu,” nawe abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Zɨyi, arakangirirya abhaatʉ.”
Nawe ataarɨ areho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aarɨ mʉkararu kʉgamba Yɨɨsu habhwɨrʉ, kʉ kʉbha bhakʉʉbhaha abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi.
Yɨɨsu ariija abhaatʉ mwihekaaru
Hanʉ zisikʉ zi isigukuru zaahikirɨ gatɨgatɨ, Yɨɨsu akaja, akasikɨra mwihekaaru, akatanga kwija abhaatʉ.
Neho abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhakarʉgʉʉra kumiija gaazɨ, bhakabhuga, “Nangʉ, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aratʉrabhwɨ komenya gʉʉsi ganʉ, neewe ataarɨ mʉsʉmi bhʉkʉngʼu?”
Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Amiija ganʉ nikwija, gatarɨ gaanɨ, nawe garuurɨ kwa wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwenda kokora chɨmbu Mungu akwenda, aramenya kʉbha, amiija gaanɨ garuurɨ kwa Mungu, hamwɨ nɨragamba kʉbhʉnaja bhwanɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akʉgamba kʉbhʉnaja bhwazɨ umwene, wuyo ariimooherya ubhukumya kwewe umwene. Nawe wʉnʉ akomohya ubhukumya kwa wʉnʉ aamutumirɨ, wuyo aragamba amaheene, atakʉgamba ʉrʉrɨmɨ.”
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kʉgamba, “Mwɨzɨ kʉbha, Musa akabhaha imigirʉ ja Mungu. Nawe atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ gatɨ waanyu wʉnʉ akugwata imigirʉ giyo. Kwakɨ moreenda kunyita?”
Abhaatʉ bhayo bhakamʉgarukirya, “Ʉna risambwa awɨ! Nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ akwenda kukwita?”
Yɨɨsu akabhagarukirya, “Nɨkakora ɨkɨsɨgʉ kɨmwɨ hanʉ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ, na niimwɨ imwʉsi mʉkarʉgʉʉra.
Rora, Musa akabhaswaja kʉsaara
abhaana bhaanyu bhiikisubhɨ. Ɨtarɨ kʉbha simʉka yiyo ɨkarwa kwa Musa, nawe ɨkarwɨra kʉbhawʉsʉʉkʉrʉ bhe embere.
Nangʉ imwɨ mʉrasaara abhaana bhaanyu nʉʉrʉ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ.
Mmbe arɨɨbhɨ mʉrasaara abhaana bhaanyu bhiikisubhɨ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ korereke mongʼehe kugwata imigirʉ ja Musa, ndora mʉranyiigatanɨra nɨraahorye ʉmʉʉtʉ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ?
Mʉtatɨnɨra ʉmʉʉtʉ kurwa kʉmangʼana ganʉ gakororekana igʉtʉ, nawe mʉtɨnɨrɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ koheene.”
Abhaatʉ bhariibhuurya arɨɨbhɨ Yɨɨsu newe Kiriisitʉ
Mmbe, abhaatʉ abhandɨ bha Yɨrusarɨɨmu hayo, bhakabha bhariibhuurya, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atarɨ wʉnʉ abhakangati bhɨɨtʉ bhakwenda kwita?
Rora, nangʉ aragamba habhwɨrʉ, nawe ebho bhatakʉmʉbhʉʉrɨra chʉchʉsi! Nangʉ, ɨratʉrɨkana, abhakangati bhɨɨtʉ bhɨɨzɨ, wuyo newe Kiriisitʉ?
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, tʉmɨnyirɨ hanʉ aruurɨ. Nawe hanʉ Kiriisitʉ umwene araazɨ, atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akomenya hanʉ aruurɨ.”
Hanʉ Yɨɨsu aarɨ ariija mwihekaaru, akatiirya riraka arabhuga, “Maheene mʉnyɨzɨ, na mwɨzɨ hanʉ niruurɨ. Inyɨ nitiizirɨ kʉbhʉnaja bhwanɨ, nawe antumirɨ nɨ‑wa amaheene. Imwɨ mʉtamwɨzɨ.
Inyɨ nimwɨzɨ, kʉ kʉbha niruurɨ kwewe na newe antumirɨ.”
Neho abhaatʉ bhakeenda kumugwata, nawe ataareho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aamugwatirɨ, kʉ kʉbha ribhaga ryazɨ rɨkɨɨrɨ kuhika.
Nawe, gatɨ wa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ hayo abhaaru bhakiisirirya Yɨɨsu. Abhaatʉ bhayo bhakabhuga, “Hanʉ Kiriisitʉ akuuza, arakora ɨbhɨsɨgʉ bhyaru kʉkɨra bhɨnʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉrirɨ?”
Abhasirikarɨ bharatumwa kugwata Yɨɨsu

Mmbe, Abhafarisaayo bhakiigwa chɨmbu riribhita rya abhaatʉ bhakumumuuza igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu. Kʉgayo, Abhafarisaayo bhayo, hamwɨmwɨ na abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, bhakatʉma abhasirikarɨ korereke bhagwatɨ Yɨɨsu.
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhʉʉrɨra abhaatʉ bhayo, “Nɨrabha na niimwɨ kwibhaga isuuhubhu. Akʉmara nɨragarʉka kwa wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
Mʉramonhya, nawe mʉtakombona. Na hanʉ nɨkʉbha inyɨ, imwɨ mʉtakʉtʉra kuuza.”

Neho Abhayaahudi bhakiibhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ araja hayi hanʉ itwɨ tʉtakʉtʉra komobhona? Nangʉ, areenda kuja kʉBhayaahudi bhanʉ bhanyaragɨɨnɨ icharʉ ɨkɨndɨ, na kwija abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatarɨ Abhayaahudi?
Nangʉ, ana nzobhoorokɨ hanʉ akʉgamba kʉbha, ‘Mʉramonhya, nawe mʉtakombona. Na hanʉ nɨkʉbha inyɨ, imwɨ mʉtakʉtʉra kuuza’?”
Yɨɨsu aragamba ukuuza kwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu
Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉkʉmariirya isigukuru ya Amabhuru, rwarɨ rusikʉ rʉkʉrʉ. Mmbe, Yɨɨsu akiimɨɨrɨra, akagamba kwiraka ikʉrʉ, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ ariigwɨ enyoota, aazɨ kwa niinyɨ, anywɨ amanzi!
Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu garabhuga, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akunyiisirirya inyɨ, ‘Zesoromonyo za amanzi gʉ ʉbhʉhʉru zɨragera kurwa kwawe.’ ”
Yɨɨsu aarɨ aragambɨra Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, yɨnʉ bhakʉhaabhwa abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwisirirya Yɨɨsu. Ribhaga riyo, Mungu aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kʉtʉma Ekoro yaazɨ kwebho, kʉ kʉbha aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kʉgʉnga Yɨɨsu habhwɨrʉ.
Abhaatʉ bharatwanɨkana igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu
Hanʉ abhaatʉ abhandɨ bha mwiribhita riyo bhiigwirɨ amangʼana gayo, bhakabhuga, “Maheene, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ newe ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri wʉnʉ tʉkʉrɨnda kurwa kwa Mungu.”
Abhaatʉ abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ newe Kiriisitʉ.” Nawe abhandɨ bhakabhuga, “Zɨyi, Kiriisitʉ atakʉtʉra kurwa mucharʉ cha Gariraaya.
Nangʉ, Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu gatakubhuga, Kiriisitʉ ararwa murwibhʉrʉ rwʉ ʉmʉtɨmi Daudi?
Na ariibhurwa Bhɨtɨrɨhɨɨmu, mʉrʉbhɨri rʉnʉ Daudi iibhwirwɨ?”
Mmbe abhaatʉ bhakatwanɨkana igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu.
Neho abhaatʉ bhakeenda kumugwata, nawe ataareho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aamugwatirɨ.
Abhakangati bha Abhayaahudi bhatakwisirirya Yɨɨsu
Mmbe, abhasirikarɨ bhayo bhakagarʉka kʉbhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani na Abhafarisaayo. Abhakangati bhayo bhakabhabhuurya, “Kwakɨ mʉtagwatirɨ Yɨɨsu na komoreeta hanʉ?”
Abhasirikarɨ bhayo bhakagarukirya, “Tʉkɨɨrɨ kwigwa ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉgamba nchewe.”
Akʉmara abhakangati bhakabhabhuurya, “Nangʉ, na niimwɨ mʉmarirɨ kʉkangiriribhwa neewe?
Areho ʉmʉkangati wʉwʉʉsi hamwɨ Ʉmʉfarisaayo nʉʉrʉ wʉmwɨ wʉnʉ akumwisirirya?
Nawe abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakumwisirirya, ni‑ribhita rya abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhatɨɨzɨ imigirʉ ja Musa. Bhiihiimirwɨ na Mungu!”
Neho Nikʉdɨɨmu, wʉmwɨ wa abhakangati bha Abhafarisaayo wʉnʉ aagiirɨ kwa Yɨɨsu rusikʉ rʉmwɨ ubhutikʉ, akabhuurya abhakɨndichazɨ,
“Nangʉ, imigirʉ jɨtʉ giriisirirya kʉtɨnɨra ʉmʉʉtʉ tʉkɨɨrɨ kumwitegeerera na kwobhoora ganʉ akʉrirɨ?”
Ebho bhakagarukirya Nikʉdɨɨmu, “Na naawɨ uruurɨ Gariraaya? Nuujɨ wiisʉnzɨ bhwaheene Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu, na ʉramenya kʉbha, atareeho ʉmʉrʉʉtɨrɨri wʉnʉ akurwa Gariraaya.”
